description: This PHP script handles file uploads for configuration restore, executes system commands to manage device configuration status, and generates an HTML page indicating restore status and prompting actions. It is part of a web interface for device configuration management.

methods.name: move_uploaded_file
methods.description: Moves an uploaded file to a new location on the server.

methods.name: exec
methods.description: Executes an external program or command.

methods.name: sleep
methods.description: Pauses execution for a specified number of seconds.

methods.name: setStr
methods.description: Sets a device configuration parameter (assumed to be a custom function).
